Open Clipferry from its icon

This window is part of the Clipferry app. Click the Clipferry icon in the menu bar (Mac) or the system tray (Windows) and choose Open Clipferry.

Connect your other computer

Install Clipferry on a computer on the same Wi-Fi, then pair the two with a one-time code. No account, no server — clips go directly and encrypted.

Devices

    Settings

    Passwords, keys and codes

    Clipferry recognises API keys, tokens, private keys, passwords and one-time codes before anything leaves this device.

    When off, clips from other devices only land in history.

    Keeps your clipboard in sync without having to open the app. Changes apply immediately.

    Off by default: AI tools see that a secret was copied, not what it is.

    Connection

    The relay only forwards encrypted data and cannot read your clips. Use the same settings on every device.

    Connect an AI tool

    Let Cursor, VS Code or any MCP client read what you copied on any of your computers.

    
    
    Then ask: “Use what I just copied on my other computer.” The snippet contains this device's private access token, so keep it to yourself. Secrets stay withheld unless you allow it in Settings.
